newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: EMS expects higher 1997 results. [CORRECTED 07:51 GMT]
newsitem.headline: EMS expects higher 1997 results. [CORRECTED 07:51 GMT]

text.p: Swiss chemicals group EMS-Chemie Group (corrects company name) said it expected its 1997 result to exceed that of 1996.
"EMS assumes that 1997 results will exceed the high level of the prior year," the company said in a statement.
It also said it expected its per share profit to rise by an even greater rate.

EMS Chemie Group reported in May that its operating profit for the first four months of 1997 rose by 58.9 percent to 65 million Swiss francs and its sales during the period were 13.3 percent higher at 349 million.
The group's 1996 net profit totalled 229 million francs. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
